messages.subject: Monte Carlo of Multidimensional IRT
parts:
All,
Is anyone aware of a monte carlo study that has been conducted on an mirt model? Basically, I am looking for a good paper that has explored the ability of an mirt model (i.e., a model with multiple latent variables) to recover the theta, difficulty and discrimination parameters? I have looked through the literature but most of the stuff I am finding is in regard to differential item functioning. I would prefer an article that has utilized the 2PL for each of the latent factors but even an article that has used polytomous data will help. I want to compare my results of a monte carlo I ran with models that have been conducted in the literature as there are no firm criteria for RMSE and bias. 
Thanks in advance for any help.
-Gene
